title: ABNT PR 2030: o que é e por que importa para as empresas brasileiras?
summary: A ABNT PR 2030 é uma norma ESG que pode ajudar sua empresa a melhorar a cadeia de abastecimento. Confira motivos e o que contempla
body_text: A ABNT PR 2030 é uma norma com diversas práticas e diretrizes envolvendo a implementação do conceito ESG nas empresas brasileiras. A principal proposta desse documento é dar orientações de como as organizações podem alinhar suas atuações aos pilares socioambientais e de governança e, com isso, se adequar a esse novo cenário tão importante para o Brasil e para o mundo. Por ser uma norma da ABNT, Associação Brasileira de Normas Técnicas, não é um documento ou regimento de atendimento obrigatório pelas companhias. Todavia, seguir essa conceitualização e padronização facilita a adoção do conceito ESG e traz uma série de benefícios para o negócio. Sobre isso, vale destacarmos que, cada vez mais, os stakeholders preferem empresas que adotam boas práticas sociais, ambientais e de governança. Por exemplo, uma pesquisa da multinacional de serviços profissionais EY, divulgada no site Exame, revelou que 99% dos investidores no Brasil direcionam suas decisões com base nas práticas ESG utilizadas pelas empresas . Quanto aos consumidores, dados apresentados pelo Google mostraram que posicionar a marca e gerar valor a partir dos pilares ESG eleva a intenção de compra dos clientes brasileiros . Motivos como esses evidenciam como é tão relevante saber o que é e o que determina a norma ABNT PR 2030. Neste artigo, falaremos sobre essa normativa, bem como sobre a importância de os agentes relacionados ao seu negócio também estarem alinhados aos conceitos socioambiental e de governança, a exemplo dos que compõem sua rede de abastecimento. Siga a leitura e confira todos esses pontos agora mesmo! O que é a norma ABNT PR 2030? A ABNT PR 2030 é uma norma ESG , visto que define conceitos, diretrizes e modelos de avaliação dos pilares pertencentes a essa sigla — ou seja, ambiental, social e de governança. Trata-se de um documento pioneiro no Brasil, apresentado em uma live pela Associação Brasileira de Normas Técnicas. De acordo com o relatado pelos representantes da ABNT no evento, essa é uma prática recomendada às empresas nacionais que visa alinhar os principais conceitos e princípios ESG . A ideia por trás dessa normativa é fornecer orientações sobre quais passos as organizações podem dar para incorporar, adequadamente, os princípios socioambientais e de governança aos seus processos. Para isso, a Associação Brasileira de Normas Técnicas formulou um material com 145 páginas com foco na criação de um padrão de conhecimento sobre a temática ESG. Essa padronização se alinha à Agenda 2030, plano global da ONU para o alcance de um mundo melhor para todos; e aos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável (ODS), que são um conjunto de ações que ajudarão a chegar a esse objetivo. Aproveite e leia também: “ Quais são os princípios ESG e seus pilares? ” O que determina a norma ABNT PR 2030? A norma ABNT PR 2030 não gera nenhuma determinação no sentido de obrigatoriedade de atendimento . Isso porque ela não é uma lei, mas, sim, um documento recomendativo voluntário, que pode ou não ser adotado pelas empresas. De forma prática, essa norma ESG funciona como base técnica para definição de regulamentações futuras relacionadas a esse conceito. E, como mencionamos logo na abertura deste artigo, seguir essas diretrizes pode ser bastante válido para seu negócio. Afinal, consiste em uma forma padronizada de trazer o conceito ESG para a realidade da companhia, a partir de diretrizes dadas por uma entidade cujas normas, quando atendidas, ajudam a elevar o nível de credibilidade e confiabilidade da sua empresa . Sobre isso, temos outro artigo interessante para você: “ ISO 14001: entenda TUDO sobre a norma de Sistemas de Gestão Ambiental ” Como aderir à norma ABNT PR 2030? Para aderir a essa norma ESG, deve-se conhecê-la integralmente. O material completo, com todas as diretrizes, pode ser adquirido no site da ABNT. Entretanto, podemos adiantar que esse documento traz um plano com sete passos voltados para a implementação de estratégias ESG às atividades da companhia, que são: 1° passo: conhecer; 2° passo: ter a intenção estratégica; 3° passo: diagnosticar; 4° passo: planejar; 5° passo: implementar; 6° passo: medir e monitorar; 7° passo: relatar e comunicar. A norma também apresenta outras orientações. São elas: modelo de avaliação e direcionamento; estágios de maturidade dos critérios ESG ; eixos ESG, ou seja, ambiental, social e de governança. Eixos ESG para adesão à norma Cada um dos eixos dessa norma é subdividido por temas e critérios. Apenas para você ter uma noção do que contempla cada um deles, confira agora alguns exemplos do que é abordado e orientado: eixo ambiental: mudanças climáticas; biodiversidade e serviços ecossistêmicos; recursos hídricos; gestão ambiental e prevenção da poluição; economia circular e gestão de resíduos. eixo social: direitos humanos; relações e práticas de trabalho; diálogo social e desenvolvimento territorial; diversidade, equidade e inclusão; promoção de responsabilidade social na cadeia de valor. eixo governança: transparência na gestão; práticas de controle e gestão; conduta empresarial; governança corporativa . Não deixe de ler este artigo: “ 5 boas práticas de governança corporativa para implementar já! ” Qual a relação da norma ABNT PR 2030 com sua rede de fornecedores? Outro ponto que mencionamos no início deste artigo foi a importância de todos os agentes relacionados ao funcionamento do seu negócio adotarem boas práticas ESG, lembra-se? O que queremos dizer com isso é que não basta sua empresa atuar de acordo com os pilares socioambientais e de governança. Para que essa conduta seja completa e traga os resultados esperados, é vital que todas as frentes sigam essa mesma linha de pensamento. Por exemplo, fornecedores cujas atividades geram desmatamento ilegal, emissão de gases poluentes, usam mão de obra escrava e estão envolvidos em práticas ilícitas como lavagem de dinheiro, entre outras condutas inadequadas, geram uma série de transtornos para a companhia contratante. No caso, trazer para sua cadeia de abastecimento fornecedores que trabalham dessa forma aumentam para os riscos reputacionais, financeiros, jurídicos e de desabastecimento, entre vários outros. E como saber qual o grau de risco ESG dos fornecedores ? O uso de ferramentas como o Linkana ESG Rating agiliza essa verificação! O que é o Linkana ESG Rating? O Linkana ESG Rating é uma ferramenta de análise automática de riscos socioambiental e de governança apresentados por uma empresa. Essa solução considera dados e informações apresentados pelos próprios fornecedores e atribui notas, considerando os três pilares ESG. body_text: So, you’ve realized your anniversary is right around the corner, yet there’s no gift in sight? Don’t sweat it! We’ll deeply dive into last-minute anniversary gifts that she’ll adore. From quick delivery options online to thoughtful DIYs, this write-up should help you save the day. Finding the perfect gift is challenging, especially under the wire. But don’t worry; these ideas will impress her and make her feel extra special on your big day. Even if it’s last minute, she doesn’t have to know! This article will cover some great picks for those needing to catch up on our shopping schedule. So, hold onto your hats because we’re about to explore some fantastic ideas that’ll have her swooning all over again. Table of Contents Custom Painting from a Photo Personalized and Handmade Gifts Romantic and Sentimental Gifts Creative and Experience-Based Gifts Tech and Subscription Gifts Practical and Useful Gifts Instant Digital Gifts Budget-Friendly Last-Minute Tokens Conclusion Custom Painting from a Photo From Instapainting Nothing says ‘special’ like a personalized gift, and when it’s down to the wire, Instapainting is here to help you win the day. This online platform has made custom art not only accessible but also convenient for everyone. Here’s what makes this service genuinely shine – it’s an artistic hub brimming with talent from all over the globe. Simply choose from a pool of artists, each showcasing their unique style and skillset. Then, watch as they transform your chosen photo into a gorgeous painting. Whether she prefers oil, watercolor, or acrylic, there’s an artist ready and waiting to create something uniquely hers. Let’s dig deeper into how it works: First off, you upload that exceptional snapshot right on their website. Next up, pick out an artist whose style speaks to her heart. Lastly, sit back and let them work their magic! But wait! There are more reasons why this makes such a significant anniversary present– it lasts forever! While flowers wilt and chocolates disappear (usually too quickly), a custom-made piece of art will be cherished for years. So, if you’re scratching your head trying to find that enchanting last-minute anniversary gift for her – look no further! A custom painting from a photo might just be the heartbeat-away solution you’ve been searching for! Personalized and Handmade Gifts Nothing says love like a gift that’s been handcrafted with tender care. When it comes to last-minute anniversary gifts, personalized, handmade presents can be your lifesaver! They’re quick, easy, and come packed with loads of sentiments. Let’s start with jewelry. It’s always a hit! A charm bracelet or necklace with her initials or both of your initials? Sounds pretty romantic, doesn’t it? Plenty of online retailers specialize in fast shipping for such items. You might even find local artisans to whip up something unique and personal on short notice. Then, there’s the idea of customized artwork. Portraits made from photographs could make her heart skip a beat. Create an artistic rendition of her favorite photo, or choose one that captures a particular moment in your relationship. Artists on platforms like Etsy offer digital services where they’ll turn a picture into an art piece within days! Besides these options, you can also consider DIY gifts if you’re crafty and have enough time before the big day arrives. Making something yourself adds an extra touch of intimacy to the present since it shows how much thought and effort you’ve put into it. Indeed, there’s no shortage of last-minute anniversary gifts when looking at personalized and handmade presents! All it takes is some creativity mixed with genuine feelings, et voilà, you’ve got a sacrifice bound to touch her heart. Romantic and Sentimental Gifts At a time when you’re racing against the clock, it’s easy to underestimate the power of a well-thought-out romantic gift. But don’t fret; here they come to your rescue – some last-minute anniversary gifts she’ll cherish. Let’s kick things off with custom jewelry. They are personal, timeless, and undeniably romantic. Think about a necklace with her initials or a bracelet engraved with a date. Online shops like Etsy have countless options that can be shipped swiftly. And to amp up the sentimental factor? Consider including a heartfelt note explaining why this piece of jewelry is significant for both of you. Now, onto something more traditional yet always delightful – flowers and chocolates! There’s hardly any woman who wouldn’t appreciate receiving her favorite blooms with gourmet chocolates. It might seem cliché, but remember, classics are classics for good reason! Next up on our list is something for those hopeless romantics out there – love letters! Yes, pouring your heart out on paper may sound old school, but trust us, it always gets appreciated. If you need help with writing, there are plenty of online services where you can get help crafting that perfect letter. All these suggestions emphasize the romance and the sentiment behind them. And while finding the perfect gift might take some effort — especially when you’re short on time — remember, the thought counts. Creative and Experience-Based Gifts He’s been counting down the days, hasn’t he? But her anniversary is just around the corner, and he still doesn’t have a gift. Don’t worry, we’ve got his back! When it comes to last-minute anniversary gifts for her, there’s nothing more enchanting than creative and experience-based surprises. So, what makes these gifts so unique? They’re all about creating unforgettable moments and sharing experiences that ignite their relationship’s spark. And don’t think that there won’t be many options available since it’s last minute – there are plenty! Picture this: She’s always wanted to attend a cooking class but never found the time or opportunity. How about surprising her with an intimate couple’s cooking session? It’s fun and lets them bond over something new and tasty. Or maybe she’s been talking non-stop about some band or artist she adores. Concert tickets make an excellent last-minute gift idea, too! Virtual concerts could do the trick if live concerts aren’t an option due to COVID-19 restrictions. And let’s remember weekend getaways! These spontaneous trips are perfect for injecting some much-needed adventure into their lives. A cozy cabin in the woods or a beach house getaway calls for a romantic escape from everyday life. Whether it’s music, travel, or culinary delights fueling their passions – there truly is an ‘experience’ gift for every woman! So next time he needs a quick yet thoughtful gift, remind him – that experiences trump material goods any day. Tech and Subscription Gifts She’s a modern woman, isn’t she? She’d likely appreciate a gift that matches her fast-paced lifestyle. So why not consider tech or subscription gifts for your last-minute anniversary surprise? Not only are these gifts easily accessible, but they also provide consistent enjoyment and utility throughout the year. Let’s start with tech gifts. If she enjoys reading books, an e-reader might be the perfect gift! She has an entire library with a device like Kindle Paperwhite. Or she’s more into fitness. In that case, fitness trackers from Fitbit or Apple Watch could be excellent choices; they can keep track of her wellness goals while also serving as stylish accessories. E-Reader: Kindle Paperwhite Fitness Tracker: Fitbit Charge 4 or Apple Watch Series 6 Now, onto subscription services! There’s no shortage of options out there. Does your lady enjoy trying new makeup, skincare products, or perfumes? Birchbox provides monthly boxes with high-end samples tailored to one’s beauty preferences. If gourmet cooking is more her style, then food delivery subscriptions like Blue Apron can bring fresh ingredients and unique recipes straight to her door. Beauty Box: Birchbox Food Delivery: Blue Apron Practical and Useful Gifts Scrambling for that last-minute anniversary gift? She’ll appreciate something that’s not just thoughtful but practical, too. Let’s dive into a few handy options that save your day. You’d be surprised how often the perfect gift is right under your nose! Have you noticed her mentioning anything she needs or wants lately? Maybe she’s been eyeing up a new gadget in the kitchen department – Instant Pots are all the rage now, aren’t they? Or perhaps she’s been craving some pampering with plush bathrobes or cozy slippers. Gifts like these tick all boxes- they’re practical, helpful, and show you’ve been paying attention! Remember to underestimate the power of tech gadgets, too. If she loves reading, an Amazon Kindle could be precisely what she needs to easily carry her library around. And if music is her thing, consider gifting her a portable Bluetooth speaker for on-the-go tunes. Let’s remember subscriptions – they can prove to be precious gifts. Here are a few top picks: Online learning platforms such as MasterClass or Coursera Meal delivery services like Blue Apron or HelloFresh Subscription boxes focused on beauty products (Birchbox), books (Book of the Month), or even wine (Winc) These subscriptions make life easier while providing entertainment–talk about hitting two birds with one stone! Instant Digital Gifts It’s down to the wire, and you’ve just realized it’s your anniversary in two days! So, what can he do? Don’t worry; we’ve got him covered with a selection of instant digital gifts she’ll adore. For starters, an abundance of eBooks out there cater to every interest imaginable. Stephen King might be a great pick if she loves thrillers or mysteries. For those who have partners who love learning and self-development, he could opt for titles from Brene Brown or Malcolm Gladwell. There’s also the option of audiobooks from platforms like Audible if she prefers listening over reading. Here are some other quick picks: Online Magazine subscriptions (like Vogue or National Geographic) Subscription boxes (many options available: beauty products, books, etc.) Music streaming services (Spotify Premium, anyone?) Gaming subscriptions for any gaming enthusiasts out there To top it off with something truly personal — consider composing a heartfelt letter expressing your love and gratitude towards her and emailing it at midnight. It doesn’t get more instant than this! In today’s digital age, where everything is readily available at our fingertips, these last-minute instant digital gifts could be life savers when one is caught unprepared. Just remember not all gifts have to come neatly wrapped in boxes; sometimes, they’re just a click away! Budget-Friendly Last-Minute Tokens Regarding affordability, you can go right with a heartfelt handwritten letter. It takes time and thoughtfulness, both priceless commodities in any relationship. Jot down your favorite moments together, express your feelings, and tell her she’s cherished. Simplicity often speaks louder than extravagance. Personalized jewelry is another fantastic option. Nowadays, many online retailers offer beguiling pieces at decent prices, from customized name necklaces to birthstone bracelets or rings. They’re affordable yet have that “special touch,” making them perfect for anniversaries. Now, if she’s more of a homebody who loves comfort above all else, consider pampering her with the following: A cozy bathrobe Scented candles An indoor plant for a breath of fresh life in her favorite corner Moving on to book lovers. If she loves getting lost in stories or learning new things from non-fiction books – gifting her latest release from her favorite author would be a great idea! Let’s not also forget experiences over materialistic gifts. How about planning a surprise date? Think picnic at the park, homemade dinner by candlelight, or even binge-watching her favorite show with gourmet popcorn! Conclusion Feeling the pressure of last-minute anniversary gift shopping? No worries, she’s got you covered. It’s common to find oneself scrambling when an important date sneaks up on us. Time constraints shouldn’t stop anyone from expressing their love and appreciation for their partner in crime! They’ve listed some beautiful options above, but don’t forget that sometimes, the simplest gestures speak volumes, too. A heartfelt note explaining why you appreciate them can be as meaningful as any novel present—don’t underestimate its power! Keep this in mind next time an anniversary takes you by surprise; it’ll help keep those last-minute panic attacks at bay. Remember: The secret ingredient in any anniversary gift isn’t extravagance—it’s thoughtfulness! So whether it’s a homemade breakfast-in-bed or a dazzling jewel from Tiffany & Co., always ensure your gift reflects your genuine affection for her.

body_text: There are a few non-negotiables in life, and one of them is dessert. Herbivores, omnivores, and carnivores—to be clear, that’s the vegans, “normal” people, and the Ketogenic followers out there—unite! We’re all just trying to figure out our optimal feeding habits and discover what works best for ourselves. We see meatless Mondays , “fasting” Tuesdays, “ raw ‘till four ” Wednesdays, blah, blah, blah. You get the idea. Everyone’s on their own journey, but no journey is complete without dessert. The tricky part, however, is that most traditional desserts include dairy, and lots of it. Whipped cream on this, ice cream as a side to that, and a glass of whole milk to wash it all down. All of our favorite desserts are typically dairy-delights; that’s just how it is. Well, that’s how it has been. Welcome to 2020. US dairy sales are expected to drop by 11% by the end of the year, and dairy-free products are on the rise. There’s milk being made from oats, cheese being made from almonds, but most importantly, desserts are hopping on this dairy-free bandwagon. And frankly, they’re killing it. Fluffy, crunchy, chewy, crumbly, and everything in between, there’s a plant-based dessert for that. Dessert is a little joy in life that adds a whole lot of happiness. Plentiful studies are praising “balance” as the key to a healthy and happy life. However, this next statistic really takes the cake; studies have shown that those who allow themselves to indulge in dessert have a greater chance of achieving and maintaining long-term weight-loss. *Fork cheers.* This is probably also a good time to point out that life is too short to eat lousy dessert. Good thing we’ve already gone out and found the best plant-based desserts and put them into this convenient list for you. These goodies have passed the taste test and are definitely five must-try vegan desserts. Why Vegan? Well, why not vegan? Plant-based and dairy-free recipes and products have come a long way in the last decade. And by “long way,” we mean vegan desserts have gone from crackers, fruit, and crumbly muffins to just about everything under the sun. Seriously, any dessert your heart desires, there’s a vegan version of it out there. Vegan desserts are filling our grocery stores, local bakeries, and even the mega fast-food chains. It’s becoming more and more common to see plant-based this and dairy-free that all over the place. Now, if we could make one suggestion – let’s refrain from calling these products “alternatives.” Sure, technically, they are alternatives, that sounds like something that’s second-choice or a back-up option. “Alternative” has a bit of a negative connotation to it. The thing is, plant-based desserts, especially these five, are stellar . These five desserts are not just some alternative trying to fill the dessert void in whatever diet you’re following. They stand on their own and need no dairy to get the credit they deserve. Are you not yet convinced that plant-based desserts are just as good (better, even) as “normal” desserts? Well, you’re about to be. Without further ado, here are the five vegan desserts you need in your life. 5 Must Try Vegan Desserts In no particular order, here are five must-try dairy-free desserts. You can read this now, enjoy them soon, and thank us later. Cookie Butter Ice Cream Cookie. Butter. Ice cream. Probably the last words you expected to hear in a vegan dessert list, right? It’s 2020, remember? Everything we thought we knew is out the window. This Cookie Butter Ice Cream is heaven-sent, and we aren’t exaggerating. Our ice cream at Eclipse is the first-ever plant-based ice cream that’s indistinguishable from conventional dairy ice cream. Swim in the velvety river of vanilla sweetness and discover chunks upon chunks of cookies that are so golden, you’ll feel like a miner. This cookie butter is crafted from 100% plants and is always non-GMO. No dairy, no GMO, just swirls of joy and deliciousness, that’s all. Seriously, plant-based dessert doesn’t compromise on taste, and after a spoonful of this ice cream, you’ll get it. We’re all screaming for this Cookie Butter Ice Cream, and we’re not even sorry. Chocolate and Vanilla Ice Cream Yes, ice cream again. This one is for all the sweet but simple people out there. Chocolate and vanilla ice cream are all-time favorites that even the dinosaurs probably enjoyed. We have Eclipse to thank again for these Vanilla and Chocolate classics. These ice creams are rich and creamy, which is precisely the way ice cream should be. No dairy, no nuts, but no sacrifice! Another wonderful thing about Eclipse ice cream is that it isn’t chalky or icy. If you don’t know what we mean by that, lucky you. Unfortunately, several dairy-free ice-cream-like desserts have a chalk-like texture and taste—yuck. It’s these chalky, dairy-free ice creams of the world that are giving cowless desserts a bad rep! Next time you’re craving a simple, sweet treat after dinner, try this ice cream for yourself. It’s so good, it’ll seem like the main attraction and the cherry on top, all at once. The only question left will be: bowl or cone? Dark Chocolate It’s a common misconception that all chocolate has dairy in it. So let us break the good news; no, not all chocolate has dairy in it. Another sweet vegan treat is a dark chocolate bar. Just make sure that you check out your chocolate goodies to ensure that they’re not only dairy free, but also that they follow fair trade practices, so you know you can feel extra good about eating your dessert. And dark chocolate can be played up too! How does almond, crispy rice, and coconut dark chocolate sound? Pretty tasty, if you ask us. A word to the wise: melt half a cup of chocolate along with a spoonful of coconut oil. Combine the ingredients in a bowl and microwave for 15 seconds, stirring and repeating until you have a smooth, silky texture. This melted chocolate is perfect for dipping strawberries, drizzling over pretzels, and just about anything else. You can even enjoy it with a small spoon or finger dipping—we don’t judge. Chocolate Covered Banana Pops Chocolate covered banana pops are a fun, easy, and tasty DIY treat you can make in a matter of minutes in the comfort of your kitchen. If Reese’s Cups, fruit, and popsicles had a baby, this is what it would be. This dairy-free dessert is low-calorie, requires less than five ingredients, and is made exclusively from whole foods. This recipe is so simple you’ll be making it in your sleep in no time. All you’ll need is: Three bananas One cup of vegan chocolate Coconut oil Peanut butter (optional) Step 1: Peel bananas and cut them in half. Insert a popsicle stick or chopstick lengthwise into the bananas pieces. Place the banana-popsicles on a baking sheet and freeze for 15 minutes. Step 2: Combine chocolate and coconut oil in a small bowl and microwave, occasionally stirring, until completely melted. Step 3: Remove the bananas from the freezer and dip them into the melted chocolate. Feel free to dip only one side, one half, or the entire thing. Optional: Use a spoonful of peanut butter to make drizzles over the banana pops. If you’re a PB lover and plan on trying this, we recommend doing the PB step after the chocolate dip. (Dipping the banana into the chocolate after it’s been covered in PB is messy…take our word for it.) Also optional: sprinkle crushed nuts, coconut flakes, or sprinkles over the banana pops. Step 4: Place the pops back on the baking sheet and back into the freezer for another 10-15 minutes. There you have it. Quick, easy, vegan, and delicious. Cookies A dessert list without cookies isn’t much of a dessert list at all. And lucky for you, there are plenty of delicious plant-based cookies out there—you must try them yourself. Going vegan doesn’t mean that you have to sacrifice your favorite desserts. We have another dessert hack for you: heat it up. A toaster oven will work best, but a conventional oven or even the microwave will suffice. Place the cookie on a baking sheet and into the oven with the “broil” setting. Depending on your desired level of toastiness, leave it in for 5-10 minutes. You now have a warm, gooey, golden, and 100% delicious dairy-free dessert. Enjoy with a spoon or pick it apart with your fingers. For the true dessert-die-hards out there, we have an extra special suggestion. Remember our new best friend, Eclipse ice cream ? Add a scoop of ice cream on top of your warm cookie. Yep. That’s all. You Need These Desserts In Your Life You need to try them. We need more of them. And heck, the entire world could use some comforting deliciousness right about now, too. Dessert can make bad days good, and good days better. Vegan desserts have come a long way; if there was ever a time to give plant-based dessert a chance, it’s now. With no dairy and no compromise, these are simply the best dairy-free desserts there are. Life’s too short to eat lousy dessert. Have one of these five must-try vegan desserts instead. title: Scully mine operator's court proceedings under CCAA.
body_text: SHANGHAI (October 13, 2023) Scully Royalty Ltd. (the “Company”) (NYSE: SRL) announces that the operator of the Scully mine has obtained an initial court order commencing proceedings under the Companies’ Creditor’s Arrangement Act (Canada) (“CCAA”). In connection with the CCAA proceedings, the operator of the mine announced that it had reached agreement for a US$75 million loan facility (debtor-in-possession), which it stated will enable it to continue operating in the ordinary course until a transaction or restructuring is completed. title: Inbound Sales 101: How to generate inbound leads and automate inbound sales
summary: Inbound sales may take time, but it can be powerful once established. This post explores how to generate inbound leads and automate the inbound sales process.
body_text: Early-stage startups must initially lean on outbound sales because they don’t have brand awareness. However, once you better understand your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and acquire initial customers, you can start inbound sales , making potential customers find you and buy your product. Inbound sales may take some time to work because you need to increase brand awareness and set up multiple marketing channels that potential customers can engage. Once established, inbound sales can be much more effective than outbound sales in the long run. Also, depending on your team's situation, you can choose between inbound and outbound sales or do both together. In this post, we'll discuss what you need to know when you first start inbound sales. Here's the agenda. How to generate inbound leads How to automate the inbound sales process Part 1: How to generate inbound leads (prospects) 1. Create content that your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) will be interested in Inbound sales is getting prospects to come to you. There are many ways to get your prospects to come to you, including word of mouth, referrals, conferences, etc. One of the most powerful and consistent ways to generate inbound leads is through content. The content should be that your ICP is interested in or that will help them do their jobs. You should first talk to your prospects and customers to decide what topics to cover. As you talk to them, you can create content about the questions they ask repeatedly or their pain points. You can also create content that gives convincing answers to your prospects' objections during the sales process. If you already have customers using your product, you can develop case studies of your loyal customers. Here's an example of blog content the Relate team wrote about a common pain point or concern among customers they met. What is CRM? How to manage sales process How to run a cold email campaign How to cold call As you start creating quality content consistently, it will compound and bring more potential customers. Also, great content helps build brand awareness and credibility. 2. Create different types of content You can create different types of content. The most common types are blogs, product guides, playbooks that utilize your product, webinars/coffee chats, podcasts, and more. You can decide what content you will create based on your team’s resources and how your prospects consume content. The advantage of utilizing different types of content is that you can reuse content you've already created elsewhere. For example, run a webinar on a specific topic and then write blog content to recap the webinar. The Relate team utilizes various content, which you can see below. Blogs Product guides Startup Wiki 3. Promote your content on multiple channels Creating great content doesn't mean anything if there's no one to consume it. Here are some common channels to promote your content. Blog subscriptions: Make your team's blog available for subscription and automatically deliver new content in a newsletter format. Community: If you are running a community, that's great, but if not, leverage external communities. LinkedIn: LinkedIn is one of the best professional social media to promote your content. You should find and leverage as many channels as possible to get your content to potential customers. 4. Use hyperlinks and calls-to-action (CTAs) If you already have relevant content created by your team, you can add hyperlinks to the new content you're creating. This will encourage prospects to spend more time on your site and naturally make them more likely to be interested in your products. Alternatively, we can gauge a prospect's interest by encouraging them to download a specific template, playbook, whitepaper, etc., but requiring them to leave their contact information. Finally, you should lead highly interested prospects to the product's landing page, where they can connect with the sales team. Currently, the Relate team uses the "Get Early Access" button in the top-right corner of the landing page or the Intercom messenger in the bottom-left corner. Part 2: How to automate the inbound sales process Getting prospects to come to you through great content doesn't mean you will be successful at selling your product. To be effective at inbound sales, you must ensure the prospects are interested in your product and get them to book a first meeting with your sales team quickly. However, it's very difficult to respond quickly to all inbound inquiries, and doing this manually is almost impossible if there are many inquiries. The simplest way to solve this problem is to use Zapier , a tool we use to automate repetitive tasks. 1. Collecting inbound lead information with Typeform Typeform is a clean and interactive survey tool to capture customer information. The following is the must-capture customer information: Company name Contact name Contact email address You can also collect other important information for your sales team to qualify prospects, such as demographics, team size, business types, and industry. 2. Let your ICP set up a time seamlessly One of the great things about Typeform is that you can offer different scenarios of questions and CTAs based on how people answer each question. You can do a basic qualification based on their answers, and then, if they're qualified, you can provide them with a calendar link to schedule a meeting right away. If you schedule meetings manually, there's a higher chance of losing them. The Relate team uses Calendly to automate scheduling meetings. For inbound leads, responding quickly (within 5 minutes) is very important so you don't lose them. Allowing prospects to choose their convenient time to leave their information is the most effective way to convert inbound leads into paying customers. 3. Automatically add inbound lead information to Relate Relate is a simple sales customer relationship management (CRM) solution. With Relate, you can easily manage your customer information, communications, contract-related information, and more. Automatically adding inbound leads to your CRM is important because it reduces the manual work for your sales team and allows you to manage customer history. With your customer information from Typeform, you can automatically add companies/organizations, reps, and deals within Relate. If you've already scheduled an appointment, you can easily add meeting notes after the first meeting, go through onboarding, and more for future sales activities. 4. Send follow-up emails to prospects You can automatically send follow-up emails to prospects who have left their information in Typeform. There are two main benefits to sending follow-up emails. Confirmation of their inquiry. Remind them if they didn't schedule a meeting right away. Bonus: What about inbound leads that didn’t schedule a meeting? In this case, the Relate team has a two-step process for managing inbound leads. 1. Email campaigns for inbound leads using Apollo.io Not all inbound leads schedule a meeting right away. If they don’t schedule a meeting after a day or so, we add them to the email campaign using Apollo.io . Emails will automatically go out until the prospect replies to the email or schedules a meeting. In our follow-up emails, we briefly explain how to effectively manage sales using Relate, interactive demos, and demo recordings. 2. Prospects who don't reply after multiple follow-ups These prospects are managed within Relate CRM with a Prospect Status of Potential. Your sales team won’t engage with prospects in the Potential status until one of the following conditions is met. Your product is updated. A similar type of prospect converts to a customer. You run an event, conference, promotion, etc. The prospect's circumstances change, such as investment news, hiring news, etc. Inbound sales may take time to work, but it can be very powerful To make inbound sales successful, it may take some time. However, once set up, it can be very powerful and sometimes more effective than outbound sales. As mentioned at the beginning of this post, you will have to lean on outbound sales during the early days. After acquiring early customers, start creating high-quality content that your ICP will be interested in. If you are successful at attracting prospects through content, automate inbound lead capturing and early sales process with CRM and other tools to increase the chance of sales.

title: Electrical Discharge Machining: Diagram, Process, and Manufacturing
summary: Electrical Discharge Machining is a subtractive manufacturing method that uses thermal rather than mechanical forces to remove material. Learn more about it here.
body_text: Fast Hole EDM Fast Hole EDM uses specialized high-pressure dielectric fluid and power supplies to drill deep, small-diameter holes at high speeds. This method is optimized for efficient hole creation in hardened materials. Fast Hole EDM is primarily used in aerospace for creating start holes for wire EDM operations or forming cooling channels in turbine blades and other high-performance components. It is also used in mold-making for precise hole creation. Micro EDM Micro EDM uses extremely fine electrodes to produce highly detailed, microscopic features with precision. The system operates at low discharge energies to ensure minimal thermal damage to delicate workpieces, allowing for micron-level accuracy. Micro EDM is commonly used in industries requiring high-precision, miniature parts, such as medical device manufacturing, electronics, and micro-mechanics. It is used for applications (micro-molding, medical implants) , and producing fine details in small components. What Does an EDM Machine Diagram Show? An EDM machine diagram shows the arrangement of the electrode, the workpiece, the power supply, and the dielectric system. The illustration clarifies how the power supply connects to the tool and the part to complete the electrical circuit. The diagram highlights the spark gap where material removal occurs. EDM diagrams commonly show dielectric circulation systems (pumps, filters, and flushing lines that direct fluid toward the machining zone). The servo motor system is depicted as the mechanism controlling the movement of the electrode. Spark generation is shown as a localized event between the two conductive surfaces. Labels identify the work tank that holds the fluid and the submerged components. Diagrams explain machine operation by visualizing the interaction of electrical and mechanical parts. Engineers use the interaction of electrical and mechanical parts to troubleshoot electrical connections or fluid delivery issues. EDM power supplies incorporate pulse generators and control circuits that regulate discharge energy, pulse duration, and frequency. Understanding the diagram helps operators visualize the non-contact nature of the erosion process. What Components Are Included in an EDM Diagram? An EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining) diagram includes several key components that are essential to the machining process. The electrode, made of conductive materials (copper or graphite), is the tool that creates electrical discharges across the gap. The workpiece is the material being machined, and it must be electrically conductive to interact with the discharges. Dielectric fluid normally acts as an electrical insulator until electrical breakdown occurs during a spark discharge, at which point it temporarily ionizes to form the plasma channel. The spark gap is the small space between the electrode and the workpiece where the electrical discharges occur, and maintaining a consistent gap is critical for stable erosion. EDM power supplies deliver controlled electrical pulses with adjustable parameters such as pulse duration, peak current, and pulse frequency. A servo control system regulates the movement of the electrode to maintain the proper gap between the electrode and the workpiece throughout the machining cycle, ensuring precision in the final part. The diagram provides a visual representation of how electrode and workpiece components work together to achieve high-precision material removal through spark erosion. Does an EDM Diagram Include the Electrode and Workpiece? Yes, both the electrode and workpiece are key components in an EDM diagram. The electrode and workpiece are central to the EDM process and are always represented in the diagram. The electrode, which creates the electrical discharges, is shown positioned close to the workpiece, with a spark gap between them. The spark gap, a critical feature, is clearly highlighted in the diagram, as it is the area where the discharge energy occurs, leading to material removal. The positioning of the electrode and workpiece is crucial to the accuracy and precision of the machining process. Short-circuiting occurs, while an excessively large gap prevents stable spark generation, reducing machining efficiency if the spark gap becomes too small. The diagram ensures that electrode and workpiece components are placed in a manner that represents the controlled environment in which the spark discharges occur, maintaining consistent gap distances for optimal machining results. What Materials Can Be Machined Using Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM)? Materials that can be machined using electrical discharge machining (EDM) are listed below. Tool Steels: Tool steels are commonly used in manufacturing tools and dies. Their high hardness makes them ideal for EDM, where intricate shapes and high-precision cuts are needed in hardened materials. Stainless Steels: Stainless steels, known for their corrosion resistance, are machined using EDM, particularly in the production of complex components that require high precision, such as medical devices and aerospace parts. Carbides: Carbides, including tungsten carbide, are hard and difficult to machine with traditional methods. EDM is ideal for machining carbide components, which are used in cutting tools, mining equipment, and wear-resistant parts. Titanium Alloys: Titanium alloys, known for their strength and resistance to high temperatures, are frequently machined using EDM for applications in aerospace, medical, and automotive industries, where precision is crucial. Superalloys: Superalloys (Inconel and Hastelloy) are used in extreme conditions. EDM provides a way to machine superalloys, tough materials commonly found in turbine blades and other high-performance components. Aluminum (Conductive Grades): All standard aluminum alloys are electrically conductive and can be machined using EDM, though EDM is less commonly used for aluminum due to faster machining alternatives (milling). This is beneficial for producing intricate shapes in lightweight and non-ferrous components Copper and Brass: Copper and brass, both conductive materials, are easily machined using EDM. Copper and brass materials are common in electrical components, connectors, and heat exchangers, where high precision and complex designs are required. 1. Tool Steels Tool steels represent a category of carbon and alloy steels known for their hardness and resistance to abrasion. These steels are used in tools that require durability and wear resistance. EDM machines treat these materials after heat treatment, avoiding thermal cracking or softening. The process ensures that hardened dies and other precision parts maintain their integrity. Tool steels are crucial in industries where high wear resistance and dimensional precision are essential, such as automotive, aerospace, and manufacturing. The EDM process allows for the efficient machining of complex parts, including with intricate shapes or thin walls. With EDM, manufacturers achieve the required tight tolerances without compromising the material’s strength or performance. The ability of EDM to create precise features in tool steels enables the production of high-quality, long-lasting tools and components. Tool Steels provide the necessary strength and durability in demanding applications, ensuring parts withstand high-stress conditions. 2. Stainless Steels Stainless steels are iron alloys that contain at least 10.5% chromium, giving them their well-known corrosion resistance. EDM can machine stainless steels without mechanical cutting forces, which avoids issues associated with work hardening during conventional machining. The EDM process allows for precise machining without altering the material’s integrity. Stainless steel is commonly used in industries such as medical device manufacturing, automotive, and food processing due to its resistance to corrosion and high-temperature strength. The ability of EDM to cut through stainless steel without inducing stress or heat distortion makes it ideal for producing components with tight tolerances. This process ensures that parts retain their strength and durability, essential for high-performance applications. EDM also provides the flexibility to machine complex shapes and fine details in stainless steel, which would otherwise be challenging using traditional machining methods. Stainless Steel components are critical in producing items that must endure harsh environments, including valves, pumps, and medical implants. 3. Carbides Carbides are materials composed of carbon combined with metals, such as tungsten or silicon. Due to their hardness, traditional tools fail to cut these substances effectively, resulting in rapid wear. EDM removes material through electrical discharge erosion (thermal melting and vaporization) rather than mechanical force. Carbides are commonly used in cutting tools, mining tools, and wear-resistant parts due to their extreme hardness. The EDM process allows for precise and intricate cuts, enabling the creation of complex shapes that would be difficult or impossible with mechanical tools. Carbide components are critical in industries such as aerospace, automotive, and manufacturing, where high durability and resistance to wear are essential. With EDM, carbide parts maintain their integrity and precise dimensions, which is crucial for high-performance applications. EDM produces very high localized temperatures at the spark site, though the heat is highly localized and generally causes less bulk distortion than mechanical cutting. 4. Titanium Alloys Titanium alloys are renowned for their high strength-to-weight ratios and biocompatibility, making them suitable for medical applications. The EDM process prevents heat-related issues such as warping and oxidation, which are common when milling these reactive metals. Specifications and details on titanium alloys are found in Titanium: Definition, Characteristics, Grades, and Applications. The alloys' ability to maintain strength at high temperatures makes them indispensable in industries such as aerospace and automotive. EDM is essential for machining titanium alloys, allowing for intricate and precise shapes while preserving the material's properties. The process is capable of achieving tight tolerances, critical for the manufacturing of aerospace components and medical implants. Titanium Alloys ensure that parts are durable and lightweight, which is crucial for applications where weight reduction is important without sacrificing strength. 5. Superalloys Superalloys, such as Inconel and Hastelloy, are high-performance metals designed to withstand extreme temperatures and mechanical stress. EDM can machine superalloys without mechanical cutting forces, but it produces a recast layer and heat-affected zone on the surface, which may require finishing passes or post-processing. Superalloys are commonly used in high-temperature applications such as jet engines and gas turbines. The EDM process ensures that the complex shapes and fine details required for superalloy components are achieved without compromising the material's strength. Superalloys maintain their performance even in extreme conditions, making them essential in industries where high durability is crucial. The precision offered by EDM helps produce superalloy parts with tight tolerances, reducing the need for post-machining adjustments. Superalloy metals are vital in the aerospace and power generation industries, where failure to meet stringent performance standards has significant consequences. 6. Aluminum (Conductive Grades) Aluminum is a lightweight, conductive metal widely used in industries like aerospace and automotive. EDM is effective on conductive grades of aluminum, enabling the creation of complex features such as internal cooling channels. EDM introduces localized thermal effects and can produce a recast layer, although it typically causes less mechanical distortion than conventional cutting due to the absence of cutting forces. The material's low density and excellent conductivity make it ideal for intricate, high-performance applications. Aluminum alloys generally do not exhibit significant work hardening during machining compared with materials such as stainless steel or nickel superalloys. The use of conductive grades of aluminum in EDM ensures that components maintain strength while being lightweight. Aluminum Metal offers enhanced performance in parts that require tight tolerances and high durability in demanding environments. 7. Copper and Brass Copper and brass are metals known for their high electrical conductivity, making them ideal for use as both workpieces and electrodes in EDM. The process enables the creation of complex connectors and electrodes used in various EDM operations. These materials are useful in applications that require intricate electrical components due to their excellent conductive properties. Copper and brass are machined using EDM, though high electrical and thermal conductivity can reduce machining efficiency compared with materials such as tool steels. The high conductivity of these metals also ensures optimal energy transfer during the machining process. The use of copper and brass in EDM allows for faster and more accurate production of electrical components. Copper Meta l is extensively utilized in manufacturing industries where high precision and electrical performance are required. What Are the Advantages of Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM)? The advantages of electric discharge machining (EDM) are listed below. Precision: EDM provides exceptional precision, allowing for the creation of intricate and complex shapes with tight tolerances. It is ideal for machining hard and difficult-to-cut materials, producing parts with fine details that would be challenging with traditional methods. No Mechanical Stress: Unlike conventional cutting methods, EDM does not apply mechanical pressure to the material. EDM removes material without mechanical cutting forces, significantly reducing mechanical deformation, though thermal effects can still influence the surface layer. Ability to Machine Hard Materials: EDM is effective on hard materials such as tool steels, carbides, and superalloys, which are difficult or impossible to machine using conventional methods. The process easily cut through hardened metals without causing cracks or thermal damage. Complex Geometries: EDM excels in producing complex geometries, including internal features (deep holes, slots, and cavities). The process is highly versatile and creates shapes that are difficult to achieve using other machining methods. Minimal Heat-Affected Zone: EDM produces a localized heat-affected zone and recast layer, which are thin but may require finishing operations for high-performance applications. Minimal Heat-Affected Zone is beneficial when working with heat-sensitive materials or requiring high levels of precision. Why Is Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM) Preferred for High-Precision Manufacturing? Electrical discharge machining is preferred for high-precision manufacturing because it achieves extremely tight tolerances. Spark control allows micro-level detail to be reproduced consistently across multiple parts. The process is ideal for creating molds and dies where micron-level accuracy is mandatory. The absence of mechanical cutting forces reduces mechanical deflection and deformation, helping maintain dimensional accuracy. EDM's ability to cut complex geometries without the risk of tool wear or deformation is another key factor in its precision. EDM produces a localized heat-affected zone and recast layer, though these are typically thin and manageable with finishing passes. further improving dimensional stability. EDM produces a localized heat-affected zone and recast layer, though these are typically thin and manageable with finishing passes. These advantages make EDM invaluable in industries like aerospace, medical device manufacturing, and automotive, where high precision is critical. Does Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM) Produce Burr-Free Surfaces? Yes, EDM produces burr-free surfaces. No mechanical cutting edges are involved in the process. Material removal occurs through vaporization instead of physical shearing, which prevents the creation of burrs. As a result, the edges of the workpiece remain smooth and clean. The absence of tool contact reduces the likelihood of material deformation or surface imperfections, which lead to burr formation. EDM produces recast layers and micro-craters, and some applications require secondary finishing processes such as polishing or secondary EDM passes. The burr-free quality of EDM makes it suitable for high-precision applications where part integrity and surface quality are critical. What Are the Limitations of Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM)? The Limitations of Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM) are listed below. Limited Material Range: EDM is primarily effective on conductive materials, meaning non-conductive materials (plastics or ceramics) cannot be machined. EDM is limited to electrically conductive materials, which include metals and some conductive ceramics or composites, not exclusively metals. Slow Material Removal Rate: The EDM process has a slower material removal rate compared to conventional machining methods like milling or turning. Slow material removal rate results in longer production times for large parts or when high volumes of material need to be removed. High Initial Setup Costs: EDM machines require significant upfront investment in both equipment and maintenance. The complexity of the machines and the precision they offer contribute to the high initial cost, which may not be ideal for small-scale operations. Electrode Wear: In EDM, the electrode material wears down during the machining process, requiring frequent replacement or re-sharpening. Electrode wear results in additional operational costs and may require more time to maintain the equipment. Heat-Affected Zone: EDM produces a localized heat-affected zone and recast layer, the thickness of which depends on discharge energy and machining parameters. The heat-affected zones lead to microstructural changes or slight thermal damage in sensitive materials. Surface Finish Limitations: Although EDM produces smooth surfaces, the finish is not as fine as those produced by grinding or polishing. Some applications may require additional post-machining processes to achieve the desired surface quality. How Does Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM) compare to CNC Machining? Electrical discharge machining differs from CNC machining primarily in the method of material removal and the speed of the operation. EDM uses a series of electrical sparks to erode material, while CNC machining employs physical cutting tools to chip away metal. EDM produces a localized heat-affected zone and recast layer, the thickness of which depends on discharge energy and machining parameters. CNC tools wear down quickly on hard alloys, increasing the cost of consumables and downtime. The EDM process achieves finer internal radii and deeper cavities that traditional rotating tools cannot reach. CNC Machining requires rigid fixturing to endure cutting forces, whereas EDM exerts no mechanical pressure on the part. Small, delicate components remain safer in an EDM environment compared to high-force CNC milling. How Does Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM) Compare to Plasma Cutting? Electrical discharge machining compares to plasma cutting as a high-precision alternative for conductive materials. EDM uses controlled electrical discharges inside a dielectric fluid to achieve high accuracy. Plasma cutting utilizes a high-temperature stream of ionized gas to melt through thick metal plates at high speeds. EDM provides a higher level of precision and a superior surface finish. Plasma cutting leaves a heat-affected zone and dross that requires secondary grinding. EDM generally produces burr-free edges, but it also forms a recast layer and localized heat-affected zone on the machined surface. Complex three-dimensional geometries and tiny holes are impossible for plasma cutters to execute. Industrial shops choose plasma for heavy-duty fabrication and EDM for precision tooling. Thick plates are processed via Plasma Cutting . Is Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM) Slower Than Traditional Machining Methods? Yes, EDM is slower than traditional machining methods. The process focuses on precision instead of speed. EDM removes material through rapid sequences of electrical discharges (thousands to hundreds of thousands of pulses per second). Engineers choose the technique for detailed components where precision requirements justify the extended cycle times. Conventional milling removes material in large chips, providing greater efficiency for basic shaping. EDM is ideal for creating complex geometries and intricate features, but comes at the cost of longer production times. Although EDM is slower, it offers unmatched accuracy and precision in materials that are difficult to machine using traditional methods. The slow speed is compensated for by the ability to produce highly detailed parts that traditional machining methods cannot achieve. While not suited for mass production, EDM excels in specialized applications requiring extreme precision. This makes EDM a valuable tool in industries such as aerospace, automotive, and medical device manufacturing.

title: PromptTTS 2: Describing and Generating Voices with Text Prompt
summary: Tutorials, guides and deep dives into the best techniques and research for building reliable AI.
body_text: Do not index Original Paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.02285 Blog URL Original Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.02285 By: Yichong Leng , Zhifang Guo , Kai Shen , Xu Tan , Zeqian Ju , Yanqing Liu , Yufei Liu , Dongchao Yang , Leying Zhang , Kaitao Song , Lei He , Xiang-Yang Li , Sheng Zhao , Tao Qin , Jiang Bian Abstract: Speech conveys more information than text, as the same word can be uttered in various voices to convey diverse information. Compared to traditional text-to-speech (TTS) methods relying on speech prompts (reference speech) for voice variability, using text prompts (descriptions) is more user-friendly since speech prompts can be hard to find or may not exist at all. TTS approaches based on the text prompt face two main challenges: 1) the one-to-many problem, where not all details about voice variability can be described in the text prompt, and 2) the limited availability of text prompt datasets, where vendors and large cost of data labeling are required to write text prompts for speech. In this work, we introduce PromptTTS 2 to address these challenges with a variation network to provide variability information of voice not captured by text prompts, and a prompt generation pipeline to utilize the large language models (LLM) to compose high quality text prompts. Specifically, the variation network predicts the representation extracted from the reference speech (which contains full information about voice variability) based on the text prompt representation. For the prompt generation pipeline, it generates text prompts for speech with a speech language understanding model to recognize voice attributes (e.g., gender, speed) from speech and a large language model to formulate text prompts based on the recognition results. Experiments on a large-scale (44K hours) speech dataset demonstrate that compared to the previous works, PromptTTS 2 generates voices more consistent with text prompts and supports the sampling of diverse voice variability, thereby offering users more choices on voice generation. Additionally, the prompt generation pipeline produces high-quality text prompts, eliminating the large labeling cost. The demo page of PromptTTS 2 is available online. Summary Notes Text-to-Speech Systems: Introducing Voice Variability with Text Prompts Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning have significantly improved text-to-speech (TTS) systems, making them sound more natural. Yet, achieving a variety of voices easily remains a challenge. Microsoft Research introduces an innovative solution, PromptTTS 2, which uses text prompts to describe and generate different voice characteristics effortlessly. Key Challenges with Voice Variability in TTS Creating varied voices in TTS systems faces two main obstacles: One-to-Many Issue : A single text prompt might need to represent various voices, complicating the capture of every voice nuance. Data Gathering Difficulty : Compiling detailed text prompts that describe voice traits is expensive and time-consuming. Introducing PromptTTS 2 PromptTTS 2 brings new strategies to overcome these challenges: Variation Network : It fills in the missing information about voice variability from text prompts, using a reference speech and a diffusion model during training. This tackles the one-to-many issue and allows for more flexible voice generation. Prompt Generation Pipeline : This automated system generates quality text prompts by understanding speech attributes and using a large language model (LLM) to write prompts. It reduces the need for manual prompt creation and enables the development of diverse voice datasets more easily. How PromptTTS 2 Works PromptTTS 2's system architecture includes: TTS Module : Responsible for synthesizing speech. Style Module : Extracts prompt and reference representations, allowing voice synthesis with just text prompts, thanks to the variation network. The Role of LLM in Generating Prompts Using a large language model for prompt generation is crucial. It detects speech attributes like gender and accent and creates descriptive sentences. This ensures a wide range of detailed text prompts, leading to more varied voice synthesis. Achievements and Future Possibilities PromptTTS 2 marks a significant advancement by: Introducing a Diffusion-Based Variation Network to manage voice variability. Creating an Automated Text Prompt Generation system, reducing reliance on manual prompts. Showing excellent results in Voice Consistency and Variability with text prompts. Looking ahead, there's potential to extract more attributes and apply this technique to other voice generation areas, opening up exciting opportunities for AI developers. Conclusion PromptTTS 2 represents a major step forward in solving voice variability challenges in TTS systems. By combining variation networks with LLM for prompt generation, it provides a flexible and quality solution for voice generation. This innovation reduces the need for extensive manual work and paves the way for creating more natural and diverse speech outputs in TTS systems. Further Reading For those interested in exploring more, reviewing literature on TTS advancements, neural networks, and machine learning applications in speech synthesis is advisable. This will deepen your understanding of the technologies and innovations driving the future of TTS systems. title: Kitekraft Connects Flying Wind Turbine Demonstrator to Public Grid
summary: As a first of its kind, Kitekraft connected its test site to Germany's public electricity grid. This marks a crucial step towards the commercialization of Kitekraft's flying wind turbine technology.
body_text: Munich, Germany, October 6, 2023: Flying wind turbine developer Kitekraft, today announces and celebrates the milestone of connecting its demonstrator to the public grid. This is the first of its kind, flying-generation, airborne wind energy system, that gets connected to the public grid globally. It is a key step towards commercialization of this new type of wind turbine. Kitekraft’s wind turbine needs 90% less material and thus comes with a much lower visual impact and lower costs compared to traditional wind turbines. The approval for the grid connection in Oberhaching near Munich was granted by the local grid operator Bayernwerk Netz GmbH. Florian Bauer (Co-CEO of Kitekraft GmbH, middle) connects the Kitekraft's flying wind turbine with the grid, supported by local grid operator Bayernwerk (represented by Thomas Agroh, left of Florian Bauer). The grid connection significantly increases the capabilities with further flight tests scheduled over the coming months, to improve the fully-autonomous flight control and efficiency, and to further validate the technology. All generated electricity from those test flights will be sold to the municipal utility company Gemeindewerke Oberhaching. All partners attended the opening event on site in Oberhaching today with mayor Stefan Schelle congratulating Kitekraft and all its partners for the successful collaboration. Stefan Schelle, mayor of Oberhaching, opens the now grid-connected test site of Kitekraft. Florian Bauer, Co-CEO and CTO of Kitekraft said: “To get our test site grid connected is a great step for Kitekraft. The generated energy, even from our prototypes, will be purchased by a local customer, making it the first time in Germany, energy from an airborne wind energy system will get paid for. Alongside the technical development, we are simultaneously working on several regulatory topics, form airspace to grid compliance, as well as interfacing with our customers to build a product that works for them. This milestone shows our progress on all these fronts.” Thomas Agroh, Head of Taufkirchen Customer Center at Bayernwerk said: “Bayernwerk supports the feed-in from more renewable energy technologies, including innovative ones like Agri-PV. Now, we have approved the very first airborne wind energy system, after Kitekraft showed compliance with applicable laws and regulation. We are continuing our support for innovative technologies such as Kitekraft’s to further progress the “Energiewende” to a carbon free energy supply, while maintaining low-cost and reliable grid operations.” Thomas Agroh, Bayernwerk, emphasizes the importance of innovation in order to tackle the energy transition. Sascha Bucklitsch, CEO of Gemeindewerke Oberhaching, said: “Our goal is to provide the entire municipality of Oberhaching with 100% green energy and we are actively looking for renewable energy generation. Today we are celebrating the connection of the first, albeit relatively small flying wind turbine demonstrator. We are eager to offtake any generated kilowatt-hour and will continue our support to integrate further prototypes and bigger commercial kites from Kitekraft in future.” First of its kind technology connected to public grid globally. At the start, the approved grid connection capacity is 30kW and the expected amount of energy generated will be limited, due to the currently small size of the demonstrator. With further progress and upscaling in the next year, the operation will gain in efficiency and energy yield. The first commercial product of Kitekraft will be a 100kW kite for farmers, municipalities, islands, and microgrids that will be upscaled to 500kW and subsequently to multi-MW systems for utility scale electricity production. Kitekraft would also like to thank further partners and supporters for the successful collaboration towards establishing this grid connection. Those include: Siemens AG, Bayern Hertz Elektrotechnik GmbH, the municipality of Oberhaching and its mayor Stefan Schelle, as well as local farmers. Part of Kitekraft's team (in company t-shirts) poses in front of the current kite demonstrator at the test site. The grid-opening event was attended by different representatives from politics, grid operators, the finance sector, development partners and customers, as well as from academia. About Kitekraft Kitekraft builds flying wind turbines, a new type of wind turbine that is a combination of a drone and kite. This enables wind power with material reduction of 90%, making it half the cost of conventional wind turbines. Website: www.kitekraft.de | Contact: info@kitekraft.de About Bayernwerk Bayernwerk Netz GmbH is the grid operator of Bavaria, Germany, and supplies a total of around seven million people with energy. It operates in the Bavarian regions of Lower and Upper Franconia, Upper Palatinate, and Lower and Upper Bavaria, making it the largest regional distribution network operator in Bavaria: its electricity network covers 156,000 kilometers. In its energy networks, the company distributes 70 percent electrical energy from renewable sources from around 400,000 decentralized generation plants. Website: www.bayernwerk.de About Gemeindewerke Oberhaching Gemeindewerke Oberhaching (GWO) was founded in 2006 as a local, community-owned energy supplier with the aim of supplying a large proportion of Oberhaching's citizens with renewable energy at favorable prices that are as stable as possible, while at the same time reducing carbon dioxide emissions. GWO offers 100 percent green electricity and is generated from renewable energies such as hydroelectric power, wind power or solar energy. In addition GWO is joint partner in the geothermal project company in Taufkirchen and offers 100 percent green heat via geothermal energy over a district heating network to Oberhaching’s citizen. title: Walking Down the Memory Maze: Beyond Context Limit through Interactive Reading
summary: Tutorials, guides and deep dives into the best techniques and research for building reliable AI.
body_text: Do not index Original Paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.05029 Blog URL blog.athina.ai /walking...-reading Original Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.05029 By: Howard Chen , Ramakanth Pasunuru , Jason Weston , Asli Celikyilmaz Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced in large strides due to the effectiveness of the self-attention mechanism that processes and compares all tokens at once. However, this mechanism comes with a fundamental issue -- the predetermined context window is bound to be limited. Despite attempts to extend the context window through methods like extrapolating the positional embedding, using recurrence, or selectively retrieving essential parts of the long sequence, long-text understanding continues to be a challenge. We propose an alternative approach which instead treats the LLM as an interactive agent, allowing it to decide how to read the text via iterative prompting. We introduce MemWalker, a method that first processes the long context into a tree of summary nodes. Upon receiving a query, the model navigates this tree in search of relevant information, and responds once it gathers sufficient information. On long-text question answering tasks our method outperforms baseline approaches that use long context windows, recurrence, and retrieval. We show that, beyond effective reading, MemWalker enhances explainability by highlighting the reasoning steps as it interactively reads the text; pinpointing the relevant text segments related to the query. Summary Notes Navigating Long Texts with MEMWALKER: A Breakthrough in Language Models The capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have been a hot topic in artificial intelligence. Yet, their difficulty with processing lengthy texts due to context window limits remains a challenge. Traditional solutions have made progress, but a more innovative approach has emerged: MEMWALKER. This method transforms LLMs into interactive agents that can effortlessly navigate through extensive texts. Let's explore how MEMWALKER works and its implications for AI Engineers in enterprise companies seeking to push the boundaries of LLMs. The Challenge of Context Windows Despite their advanced capabilities, LLMs are constrained by their context windows, limiting their ability to comprehend lengthy texts in one go. Existing strategies to mitigate this issue include: Scaling Context Windows : Trying to enlarge the context window size. Recurrence : Architectures that remember previous inputs. Retrieval : Fetching relevant information from a broader text corpus. Reasoning Agents : Systems that interact with texts to collect necessary information. While helpful, these strategies often struggle with the complexity and length of real-world texts. MEMWALKER: A New Approach MEMWALKER introduces a fresh perspective by enabling an interactive reading experience. It does so through two main processes: Creating a Memory Tree : It breaks the text into smaller segments and organizes them into a hierarchical structure. Navigation : It uses this memory tree to identify and engage with pertinent text segments based on queries. This method significantly broadens the model's effective context window, allowing it to handle long texts more efficiently without needing architectural changes. Advantages Demonstrated in Experiments In comparisons with traditional models, MEMWALKER excelled in processing long texts, particularly in answering complex questions. Its success lies in: Better reasoning, guiding it to navigate texts intelligently. Effective management of its working memory, adapting dynamically to tasks. An ability to correct its mistakes through its iterative, interactive process. These strengths highlight MEMWALKER's potential to redefine LLM interactions with long texts, indicating a step towards more capable language models. Challenges Ahead However, MEMWALKER isn't without its obstacles. Scalability and reliance on the LLM's reasoning skills pose challenges. Its current reliance on zero-shot prompting also suggests room for optimization, especially for specialized tasks. Conclusion: Broadening LLM Horizons MEMWALKER represents a significant leap forward, enabling LLMs to transcend their context window limitations through interactive reading. This approach promises to enhance LLMs' ability to process extensive texts without major modifications, marking a milestone in AI applications. For AI Engineers in enterprise settings, this opens up possibilities for deploying LLMs in more intricate and text-intensive scenarios, such as legal document analysis and detailed report generation, ushering in new levels of understanding and productivity. With MEMWALKER, we're on the cusp of a new era in language model capabilities.
